summary: Empower your career with our Women in Technology Training Course. Gain essential skills, network with industry leaders, and break barriers in tech.
lede: Technology career development for women focuses on practical progression in technical workplaces. Designed for women entering or advancing in technology roles, the course helps learners assess skills against role expectations and project, incident and service evidence, communicate requirements clearly, influence stakeholders, and build a career roadmap and portfolio for development discussions.
audienceIntro: This women in technology training is designed for women who want practical support for progression in technology environments, whether you work in delivery, support, analysis, or leadership support roles.
modules: Skills Mapping with COBIT and ITIL
prerequisites: Prerequisites are light, but you will benefit most if you already have basic workplace exposure to technology teams, digital tools, or project work. No coding is required to complete this women in technology training, although familiarity with common workplace software, shared documents, and online collaboration platforms will help you complete the exercises faster. This course is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who want structured support for confidence, visibility, and career planning in technology roles.
